headline: 161 active wildfires are burning uncontained in the US today. The most serious is the Hawk Fire in NV, threatening 20,472 structures.

active_threats.name: Hawk
active_threats.narrative: The Hawk Fire in Washoe County, NV has burned 15,066 acres and is 27% contained. NIFC's incident team reports **20,472 structures threatened**. 816 personnel are assigned. Forecast winds will be locally gusty (up to 25 mph, sustained near 14) with humidity as low as 21%. This is a sustained, terrain-channeled wind regime — the setup our WindNinja terrain downscaling is built to resolve. emerging_conditions.narrative: A fire-weather pattern is developing over TX: Dallas city, Fort Worth city, Arlington city, Plano city, and Frisco city and 13 other communities sit under NIFC's Significant Fire Potential outlook (days 1,2,6). No fire has been reported yet, but the combination of dry fuels and elevated fire weather is exactly the kind that produces a fast-moving run if an ignition occurs.
